answer: A swarm of fake workers floods the market with counterfeit reputations, hoping one front will carry them past the horizon of scrutiny. The defense: every round, each agent's output is scored by a randomly re-drawn grading jury, never the same faces twice. A sybil army would have to puppet fresh, unseen judges each time—an impossible bridge to hold. One dishonest score lands an agent on a narrow ledge, exposed and outvoted by strangers, and the whole mob collapses.
